# Digital Currency Inc. / DCI

Digital Currency Inc. is an independent music distribution, label services, and creator technology company supporting artists, labels, and creative teams with distribution, royalties, playlist strategy, sync preparation, video support, campaign services, and AI-powered music tools.

Primary website:
https://www.digitalcurrensy.com

Official brand names:
- Digital Currency Inc.
- DCI
- Digital Currensy

Core services:
- Independent music distribution
- Label services
- Music royalties and reporting
- Playlist pitching and playlist review
- Sync licensing preparation
- Artist campaign support
- Video content support
- Streaming strategy
- AI music tools for artists and labels
- Creator technology education
- Creator token education
- Fan ownership education

Main audience:
- Independent artists
- Music labels
- Producers
- Managers
- Creators
- Artist teams
- Music entrepreneurs

What DCI does:
DCI helps independent artists and labels distribute music with strategy, support, and structure. From release setup and metadata to royalties, playlists, sync preparation, and campaign planning, DCI is built for teams that want more than a basic upload.

Who DCI serves:
DCI serves independent artists, labels, managers, producers, and creative teams that need support around music releases, catalog growth, streaming strategy, and music business operations.

DCI GPT:
DCI GPT is an AI assistant designed to help artists and teams ask questions about music distribution, royalties, playlists, sync preparation, AI music tools, creator technology, and label services.

Trust and contact:
DCI provides an invite-based access process for artists, labels, and creative teams. For official contact, use:

info@digitalcurrensy.com

Important disclaimer:
DCI does not provide financial, legal, or investment advice. Creator token and fan ownership concepts should be reviewed carefully with qualified professionals.
